name: LOLIN (WEMOS) D1 mini
description: The classic $2-4 ESP8266 board: 4 MB flash, CH340 USB, 11 GPIOs and the biggest shield ecosystem (OLED, relay, SD, battery); the cheapest Wi-Fi board that still has loads of tutorials.
notes: ESP8266EX, 3.3 V only. Single 10-bit ADC (A0, max 3.2 V via on-board divider). D0 (GPIO16) has no PWM/I2C/interrupt; D3, D4 (LED) and D8 are strapping pins.
The current official LOLIN V4 has USB-C; the common $2 clones are Micro-USB with CH340C or CP2104 (CH340 driver needed on some OSes).
2x8 header, rows 22.86 mm apart (header data from the official KiCad footprint: first pin 8.21 mm from the antenna end). ESP8266 is legacy; a C3 mini is a better buy for new designs.
